architecture_decisions: Jamstack architecture using Eleventy (11ty) for static site generation.
Zero-cost deployment on Cloudflare Serverless ecosystem (Pages, Workers).
Offline-first PWA implementation via service-worker.js and manifest.json.
Zero-backend client-side search using a compressed local JSON index.
Component templating utilizing Nunjucks (e.g., header.njk, footer.njk).
CSS Consolidation: All styles merged into a single style.css to eliminate render blocking.
business_logic: Client-side SPA routing with hash-based deep linking (e.g., /#/flashcards) and 404.html fallback redirects.
Bilingual pedagogical model focusing on SOV (Hindi) to SVO (English) transition via Hinglish.
Flashcard engine utilizing spaced repetition and Devanagari pronunciation formatting.
Activity tracker logging daily minutes in localStorage with collapsible time trees.
Device anti-fraud with 3-device limit via JWT/fingerprintjs and Google Sign-in.
user_preferences: Mobile-first navigation: primary links in bottom-nav, secondary links in a hamburger drawer.
Premium UI styling using glassmorphism (backdrop-filter blur, soft borders, glow shadows).
High readability: 17px base font size, 1.75 line-height, and increased card paddings.
Smooth and modern spring animations defined by cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1).
Accessibility for animations: infinite loops disabled via @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce).
code_standards: Strictly Vanilla HTML, CSS, and JS. Avoid heavy JavaScript frameworks.
Mandatory use of CSS variables (e.g., var(--bg-base), var(--accent)) for theme tokens.
Strict UI accessibility: implement focus traps in modals/drawers and comprehensive ARIA tags.
Performance constraints: Keep DOM nodes under 1000 and utilize system-ui fallback fonts.
AI Agents must follow 'Zero-Output Execution' avoiding massive console outputs to conserve tokens.
